name: Backup Destinations
description: Unlocks remote backup destination UIs in CPN Panel: Google Drive, remote SFTP/SCP, S3-compatible object storage, and Incremental (restic) jobs. Create, Restore, Schedule, and local Destinations stay in core. Free Host package.
author: master3395
uninstall_impacts: Hides Google Drive, Remote SFTP/SCP, S3, and Incremental backup UIs until the plugin is installed again
Clears the host backup-destinations feature flag
Create, Restore, Schedule, and local Destinations stay available
Does not delete existing local backup archives or stored destination secrets
